Dear Madam
I enclose the deed for [Mrs. Yonge](/person/1604)’s signature in one place only where you will see her name written in pencil. [^1] This signature should be made in the presence of a witness who will sign where shewn adding address & occupation, a householder is best, but a servant will do. You must not, of course, be the witness. Please leave the date blank & return me the deed as soon as possible as it has to be stamped &c.
I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](/person/2094)
Miss Yonge
70 Kensington Gardens Square


[^1]: The deed transferring the insurance policy on Frances Yonge’s life to CMY.
